targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.ticket_id) AS tickets
FROM grafana_staff_activity a
WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(a.created_at)
  AND a.staff_user_id IN ($staff)
  AND a.ticket_type IN ($ticket_type)
  AND IFNULL(a.server, 'none') IN ($server)
  AND (
    '$involvement' = 'all'
    OR ('$involvement' = 'first_responder' AND a.is_first_responder = 1)
    OR ('$involvement' = 'closer' AND a.is_closer = 1)
    OR ('$involvement' = 'stale' AND a.is_stale_pickup = 1)
  )

SELECT AVG(a.handle_after_pickup_seconds) AS avg_handle_after_pickup
FROM grafana_staff_activity a
WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(a.created_at)
  AND a.handle_after_pickup_seconds IS NOT NULL
  AND a.staff_user_id IN ($staff)
  AND a.ticket_type IN ($ticket_type)
  AND IFNULL(a.server, 'none') IN ($server)
  AND (
    '$involvement' = 'all'
    OR ('$involvement' = 'first_responder' AND a.is_first_responder = 1)
    OR ('$involvement' = 'closer' AND a.is_closer = 1)
    OR ('$involvement' = 'stale' AND a.is_stale_pickup = 1)
  )

SELECT SUM(a.message_count) AS messages
FROM grafana_staff_activity a
WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(a.created_at)
  AND a.staff_user_id IN ($staff)
  AND a.ticket_type IN ($ticket_type)

FROM grafana_staff_activity a
WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(a.created_at)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  a.ticket_id AS ID,
  a.ticket_type AS Type,
  IFNULL(a.server, 'none') AS Server,
  tm.opener_name AS Opener,
  FROM_UNIXTIME(a.created_at) AS Opened,
  FROM_UNIXTIME(a.first_message_at) AS `First msg`,
  FROM_UNIXTIME(a.close_time) AS Closed,
  tm.close_user AS Closer,
  tm.close_type AS `Close type`,
  tm.close_reason AS Reason,
  a.queue_wait_seconds AS Queue,
  a.handle_after_pickup_seconds AS Handle,
  a.age_at_engagement_seconds AS Age,
  a.message_count AS Msgs,
  a.is_first_responder AS Pickup,
  a.is_closer AS `Did close`,
  a.is_stale_pickup AS Stale,
  tm.transcript_url,
  'Ticket ID. Click to open the transcript.' AS __tip_ID,
  'Ticket type.' AS __tip_Type,
  'Game or community server.' AS __tip_Server,
  'User who opened the ticket.' AS __tip_Opener,
  'When the ticket was created.' AS __tip_Opened,
  'When this staff member first messaged on the ticket.' AS __tip_First_msg,
  'When the ticket was closed.' AS __tip_Closed,
  'Staff member who closed the ticket.' AS __tip_Closer,
  'How the ticket was closed.' AS __tip_Close_type,
  'Close reason.' AS __tip_Reason,
  'Time from created to first staff reply. Team wait, not this person score.' AS __tip_Queue,
  'Time from this person first message to close.' AS __tip_Handle,
  'Time from created to this person first message.' AS __tip_Age,
  'Staff messages this person sent on this ticket.' AS __tip_Msgs,
  '1 if this person was first staff to reply.' AS __tip_Pickup,
  '1 if this person closed the ticket.' AS __tip_Did_close,
  '1 if this person was first to reply after more than 4 hours in queue.' AS __tip_Stale
FROM grafana_staff_activity a
INNER JOIN grafana_ticket_metrics tm ON tm.ticket_id = a.ticket_id
WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(a.created_at)
  AND a.staff_user_id IN ($staff)
  AND a.ticket_type IN ($ticket_type)
  AND IFNULL(a.server, 'none') IN ($server)
  AND (
    '$involvement' = 'all'
    OR ('$involvement' = 'first_responder' AND a.is_first_responder = 1)
    OR ('$involvement' = 'closer' AND a.is_closer = 1)
    OR ('$involvement' = 'stale' AND a.is_stale_pickup = 1)
  )
ORDER BY a.created_at DESC
LIMIT 2000
